title: Wu Xuan, the Fallen General (堕落将军 武轩) - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Wu Xuan, the Fallen General (堕落将军 武轩) in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Wu Xuan, the Fallen General (堕落将军 武轩) is a story encounter in Pangzhen, found at Back Street Archway bell. Beating it yields Wolfjaw.

sections.title: Where to Find the Wu Xuan, the Fallen General (堕落将军 武轩)
sections.content:
Location: Back Street Archway bell.

Appears in: Pangzhen.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is mandatory, so it cannot be walked past - the fight is worth learning rather than trying to out-level.

sections.title: How to Beat the Wu Xuan, the Fallen General (堕落将军 武轩)
sections.content:
What works

  • He hides behind a defensive stance - heavy attacks break it faster than a combo.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 25 of 60 in the progression order, in Pangzhen. Before it: Cavalrybane (鬼差高手 斩骑). After it: Gu Wanyue (女妖 骨婉约). The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
